expect:
Top band (7-8): Comprehensive discussion referencing at least three methods with clear justification for a sci-fi context. E.g. Environmental recording could capture industrial ambiences as a base for alien landscapes. Effects libraries provide quick access to generic sci-fi elements. expect:

Automation allows the soundtrack to evolve dynamically rather than staying static.
